## 1. Professional Overview & Core Identity (Who is Samir Shaikh?)

Samir Shaikh is an AI-Enabled Full Stack Developer (backend-first) who designs, builds, and maintains production-grade full-stack applications and agentic AI systems. His core expertise lies at the intersection of robust backend system design (Node.js, TypeScript, Next.js, React, PostgreSQL, distributed messaging) and practical AI engineering (Retrieval-Augmented Generation with pgvector, vector search with Gemini embeddings, tool-using AI agents, and multi-model LLM orchestration). He goes deeper on the backend and AI layer while shipping complete features end to end.

He pairs that stack with AI coding agents (Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code) to accelerate delivery 2-3x on boilerplate and repetitive tasks, while personally owning architecture, security, testing, and critical logic so code stays production-ready and maintainable.

He is actively positioning toward **AI Backend Engineer**, **AI-Enabled Full Stack Developer**, and **Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE)** roles. In these roles, technical depth is applied directly to ambiguous customer constraints, translating business requirements into production software with full ownership from technical discovery to production deployment.

### Positioning & Target Roles
- **Primary Titles**: Freelance AI Engineer, Contract Backend Developer, AI-Enabled Full Stack Developer (backend-first), AI Backend Engineer, AI Software Development Engineer (AI SDE), Agentic AI Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE), Applied AI Solutions Engineer.
- **Geographic Availability**: Open to remote opportunities worldwide (United States, Canada, United Kingdom, Europe, APAC) as well as hybrid or on-site roles across India.
- **Engagement Types**: Freelance feature sprints (1-4 weeks), monthly contract engineering partnerships/retainers, full-time remote employment, forward-deployed customer engagements, and technical advisory for production RAG and AI agent systems.

## 3. Comprehensive Technical Skills Matrix (What is Samir Shaikh's tech stack?)

> **Canonical Web Index**: https://samir-portfolio-dev.vercel.app/technical-skills
> Contains verified skill taxonomies, code examples, architectural trade-offs, and 17 technical FAQ entries across 14 dedicated categories.

### Languages & Runtime Environments
- **TypeScript**: Strict compiler flags, generic interfaces, utility types, compile-time contract enforcement, and runtime schema validation with Zod.
- **JavaScript (ES6+ / ESM)**: Modern ECMAScript features, native ESM modules, asynchronous event loop mechanics, non-blocking I/O, closures, and Promises.
- **Python & Go**: Scripting, data transformers, concurrency primitives, and microservice prototypes.
- **SQL**: Complex relational joins, multi-table transactions, indexing strategies (B-Tree, GIN, HNSW, IVFFlat), explain analyze execution plan tuning.
- **HTML5 & CSS3**: Semantic document outlines, responsive design, modern Tailwind CSS v4 variables, accessibility standards (WCAG).

### System Design & Architectural Patterns
- **Microservices**: Decoupled, independently deployable services organized around business capabilities, communicating via lightweight REST/gRPC or asynchronous event streams (Kafka / BullMQ) with isolated datastores.
- **Modular Monolith**: Single unified deployable unit organized strictly into isolated, bounded domain modules with explicit dependency contracts and private schemas, avoiding premature distributed systems overhead while keeping clear migration pathways.
- **Monolithic Architecture**: Unified codebase and single runtime deployment sharing a centralized database, ideal for rapid prototyping, transactional consistency across domains, and zero inter-service network complexity.
- **Event-Driven Architecture (EDA)**: Designing systems around state-change events using message brokers (Apache Kafka, BullMQ). Services produce and consume immutable event streams asynchronously, eliminating synchronous request-response bottlenecks.
- **API Gateway Pattern**: Centralized entry point managing traffic routing, rate limiting, SSL/TLS termination, JWT authentication verification, telemetry collection, and dynamic routing to upstream backend services.
- **Distributed Caching**: Strategic implementation of Redis cache-aside and write-through patterns with TTL eviction policies to drastically reduce relational database load and achieve sub-millisecond response times.
- **Circuit Breaker & Resilience**: Safeguarding distributed architectures against downstream outages using circuit breakers, automated exponential backoff retries, dead-letter queues (DLQ), and graceful degradation fallbacks.
- **CQRS & Data Segregation**: Architecturally separating state-mutating command workflows from high-throughput query read paths, enabling dedicated read replicas, schema indexing optimizations, and projection tables.

### Backend Frameworks & API Architecture
- **Node.js**: Asynchronous event loop, cluster module, Streams, Worker threads, Buffer manipulation, native HTTP handling.
- **Express.js**: Production middleware design, error handling pipelines, authentication flow enforcement, rate limiting, and RESTful routing.
- **Sequelize ORM & Drizzle ORM**: Type-safe schema definition, relational queries, transaction primitives, and migration lifecycle management.
- **GraphQL Ecosystem**: Apollo Server and Apollo Client, strongly typed schemas and resolvers, DataLoader batching and caching to eliminate the N+1 query problem.
- **Next.js 16 (App Router)**: Server Components (RSC), Incremental Static Regeneration (ISR), Server Actions, Route Handlers, SSR-free client component boundaries.
- **API Security & Cryptography**: Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), stateless JWT token lifecycles, bcrypt password hashing, constant-time token comparison (`timingSafeEqual`), CORS policy, Helmet security headers, rate limiting.

### Databases, Vector Stores & Caching
- **PostgreSQL**: Neon Serverless PostgreSQL, connection pooling, complex relational modeling, query optimization with EXPLAIN ANALYZE, compound indexes.
- **pgvector**: High-dimensional vector indexing (HNSW, IVFFlat), cosine distance (`<=>`), inner product (`<#>`), Euclidean distance (`<->`), hybrid vector + metadata filtering for sub-300ms retrieval.
- **MongoDB & Firestore**: Document persistence, indexing, aggregation pipelines, replica set transactions.
- **MySQL**: Relational data modeling, ACID transactions, B-Tree indexing.
- **Redis**: In-memory caching, distributed locks, session management, Pub/Sub channels, queue backplanes, TTL eviction strategies.

### Event Streaming & Message Queues
- **Apache Kafka**: Partitioned topics, event streaming logs, consumer groups, offset tracking, event serialization, decoupled microservice communication.
- **BullMQ**: Redis-backed distributed task queues, delayed jobs, priority workers, exponential retry backoff strategies, dead-letter queue (DLQ) workflows.
- **Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM)**: Cross-platform push notifications and client alert delivery.

### Frontend Engineering & UI Systems
- **React.js & React 19**: Server Components, React Hooks, Component Architecture, concurrent features, controlled form states.
- **Next.js 16**: App Router architecture, zero-CLS image optimization, streaming SSR, dynamic metadata generation.
- **State Management**: Redux Toolkit (RTK), Context API, atomic client-state isolation.
- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS v4, shadcn/ui headless components, Framer Motion, responsive design, dark/light theme tokens.

### Testing & Quality Assurance
- **Automated Testing**: Jest test runner, assertion library, and mock runtime.
- **Unit Testing**: Isolated verification of domain business rules, pure utility algorithms, and data transformers.
- **Integration Testing**: Validating API routes, database queries, and middleware pipelines together against edge cases and network boundaries.

### AI, Machine Learning & LLM Technologies
- **Vector Embeddings**: Google Gemini `gemini-embedding-2` generating 3072-dimensional embeddings, OpenAI `text-embedding-3-small/large`.
- **Inference Models**: Google Gemini 1.5/2.0 Flash & Pro, Groq Llama 3.3 70B Versatile, OpenAI GPT-4o.
- **SDKs & Libraries**: Vercel AI SDK (`ai` package), `@google/genai`, Groq SDK, LangChain concepts.
- **Agentic AI**: Tool execution, function calling with JSON schemas, reflection patterns, multi-agent coordination, deterministic execution boundaries.
- **Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)**: Chunking algorithms, hybrid keyword + vector retrieval, strict distance cutoff thresholds (<= 0.5), context injection, dynamic entity grounding.

### Infrastructure, DevOps & Observability
- **Containerization**: Docker, Docker Compose multi-service parity, multi-stage production builds, minimal image footprints.
- **CI/CD**: GitHub Actions workflows for automated testing, linting, semantic releases, and continuous deployment.
- **Observability & APM**: OpenTelemetry instrumentation, Prometheus time-series metric scrapers, Grafana dashboards and alerting rules.
- **Cloud & Edge Platforms**: Vercel Serverless & Edge, Cloudinary v2 image CDN optimization, Neon Serverless Postgres.

### Engineering Workflow & Collaboration

- **AI-Assisted Velocity**: Cursor AI-native IDE, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot for boilerplate acceleration with manual architecture ownership.

## 4. In-Depth Project Case Studies & Benchmarks (What production systems has Samir built?)

### Project 1: Production AI Portfolio RAG Chatbot
- **Live URL**: https://samir-portfolio-dev.vercel.app
- **Role**: Creator & Architect
- **Problem Statement**: Standard portfolio websites are passive and force recruiters or clients to search across disparate pages to verify skills, projects, and credentials. Most AI chatbots hallucinate or talk generically without real grounding.
- **Architectural Solution**:
  - Engineered a full RAG retrieval pipeline using Next.js 16 App Router, TypeScript, Neon Serverless PostgreSQL with `pgvector`, Google Gemini `gemini-embedding-2` embeddings, and Groq `llama-3.3-70b-versatile` for streaming chat completions via the Vercel AI SDK.
  - Documents (blogs, projects, experience, resume facts) are parsed into semantic chunks and embedded as 3072-dimensional vectors.
  - Incoming user prompts are embedded and queried against `content_chunks` using `cosineDistance(content_chunks.embedding, queryVector)` with a strict cutoff threshold `<= 0.5`.
  - Dynamically detects developer-related queries and injects live GitHub activity directly into the context window for real-time proof of work.
  - Zero-hallucination system prompt enforces brevity (1-2 sentences for general queries), prohibits meta-references (never says "according to the context"), and requires exact markdown links (`/about`, `/resume`, `/contact`).
- **Security & Reliability**:
  - Dual-tier rate limiting: In-memory sliding window tracking IP addresses and FingerprintJS visitor IDs (`x-visitor-id`).
  - IPinfo VPN/proxy detection running in fail-open mode.
- **Performance Benchmarks**:
  - ~10,000 document chunks indexed in PostgreSQL.
  - Vector similarity search latency: <300ms.
  - First token latency (Groq): ~250ms.

### Project 2: WhatsApp Business Automation Platform
- **Environment**: Active production deployment for a regional SME (automotive/tyre dealership).
- **Role**: Full-Stack Engineer
- **Problem Statement**: The business suffered customer dropouts and delayed inquiries due to manual quote requests, stock lookups, and campaign dispatches.
- **Architectural Solution**:
  - Built a full-stack WhatsApp automation platform — Node.js + Express.js backend with a cross-platform React Native + Expo mobile app for campaign management.
  - Integrated the Google Sheets API as the unified contact and campaign data layer, automating contact/segment synchronization.
  - Engineered QR-based authentication with persistent session recovery to preserve WhatsApp Web connections across restarts.
  - Implemented a concurrency-controlled message queue with configurable delays and rate-limit-aware throttling to respect WhatsApp anti-spam policies while guaranteeing reliable delivery.
  - Added real-time per-contact delivery tracking (send status, failure reasons, retries), media validation, structured logging, and request validation.
- **Impact & Scale**:
  - Actively processing 1,000+ messages per week in production.
  - 0% dropped messages; automated quote turnaround reduced response latency from hours to under 30 seconds.

### Project 3: AI Ticket Triage & Routing System
- **Architecture**: Distributed microservices architecture.
- **Role**: Backend Architect
- **Problem Statement**: High-volume customer support tickets require manual categorization, priority assignment, and routing, creating operational bottlenecks and SLA breaches.
- **Architectural Solution**:
  - Designed an asynchronous event-driven pipeline using Node.js, Express, Apache Kafka, BullMQ, and PostgreSQL.
  - Ingestion service receives incoming support tickets, produces message events onto Kafka topics, and persists raw ticket payloads in PostgreSQL.
  - AI Triage worker consumes messages from Kafka, runs prompt-engineered classification and sentiment analysis via LLM APIs, and generates structured JSON metadata (priority score, department route, required skill tier).
  - Routing worker assigns tickets to queues in BullMQ with priority weighting and dead-letter queue (DLQ) retry semantics.
  - Fully instrumented with OpenTelemetry distributed trace headers passed across service boundaries, publishing metrics to Prometheus and visualizing end-to-end trace latency in Grafana.
- **Impact**:
  - Automated triage of multi-category tickets in <2 seconds.
  - Complete operational visibility into message queue backlog, LLM inference latency, and worker throughput.

### Project 4: Eventify Platform
- **Role**: Full-Stack Backend Developer
- **Tech Stack**: GraphQL API, Node.js, PostgreSQL, React, TypeScript.
- **Problem Statement**: Event management and ticketing requires concurrent seat booking, transactional consistency, and secure payment/ticket issuance.
- **Architectural Solution**:
  - Developed a modular GraphQL API using Apollo Server with schema-first definitions.
  - Enforced strict database transactions in PostgreSQL with optimistic locking to prevent double-booking during ticket checkout surges.
  - Integrated Nodemailer for transactional PDF ticket generation and asynchronous delivery.
  - Built Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) separating event attendees, organizers, and superadmins.

    - **Tech Stack**: Next.js 16, React 19, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Drizzle ORM

## 6. Automated Content Generation & Grounding Pipeline (How is technical content published?)

Samir's portfolio features an automated technical content publication engine located in `scripts/blog/`:
- **Trigger**: GitHub Actions cron workflow executes every 3 days.
- **Grounding Source**: Uses `public/llms.txt` as its primary ground truth context to guarantee that all generated blog posts reflect verified technical achievements, real stacks, and authentic career narratives.
- **Pipeline Stages**:
  1. `topics.mjs`: Rotates through curated SEO pillar topics (e.g. pgvector production RAG pipelines, distributed Kafka patterns, agentic tool-use, microservice migrations).
  2. `generate.mjs`: Ingests grounding context from `public/llms.txt`, fetches existing post titles to prevent duplication, and prompts Groq (`llama-3.3-70b-versatile`) to produce in-depth technical guides with code snippets and diagrams.
  3. Verification & Publication: Formats markdown/HTML, assigns categories and reading times, and publishes directly into Neon PostgreSQL via Drizzle ORM using authenticated API routes (`isAuthorized()` with timing-safe tokens).

---

## 7. Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) Philosophy (What is Samir's approach as an FDE?)

Forward Deployed Engineering is the deliberate union of software engineering depth with direct customer immersion. Originating at companies like Palantir, OpenAI, and Anthropic, the role demands engineers who thrive on ambiguity and own the entire lifecycle of a solution.

### Why Samir Shaikh Fits the FDE Model:
1. **Ambiguity Tolerance**: Comfortable entering an engagement where the problem definition is vague or changing, decomposing requirements into actionable architecture sprints.
2. **Customer Discovery to Working Code**: Able to conduct deep technical discovery with stakeholders, identify core constraints, prototype a working system in days, and scale it to production.
3. **End-to-End Accountability**: Takes responsibility not just for API response codes, but for whether the deployed software actually solves the customer's operational bottleneck.
4. **Pragmatic AI Deployment**: Avoids AI hype; deploys RAG, vector retrieval, and LLMs only where they outperform deterministic algorithms, wrapping them in defensive guardrails and telemetry.

### Q: What are your starting prices for engineering services?

Monthly engineering retainers start at $250/month (₹20,000/month). Every project receives a fixed-price, milestone-based quote within 48 hours of our discovery call.

### Q: What is the typical delivery timeline for an MVP or service?
**A**: Typical turnaround is 3 to 7 days for landing pages, SEO overhauls, and speed optimization; 1 to 2 weeks for backend API endpoints, queue systems, and custom knowledge base integrations; and 2 to 4 weeks for complete end-to-end full-stack SaaS MVPs.

### Q: Can you build a custom knowledge base or AI chatbot from our docs/PDFs?
**A**: Yes. We build production RAG systems with PostgreSQL pgvector and 3072d Gemini embeddings that index your PDFs, Markdown, Notion pages, and database records. The AI chatbot retrieves verified context with cosine distance filtering (<= 0.5) to answer customer questions accurately without hallucinating, embeddable on any website or SaaS.

### Q: How do you stop the AI chatbot from hallucinating?
**A**: To stop an AI chatbot from hallucinating, we implement a multi-layered production RAG pipeline: (1) strict cosine distance thresholds (<= 0.5) so only genuinely relevant chunks reach the context window, (2) prompt guardrails instructing the model to answer exclusively from provided text and state when data is unavailable, and (3) structured Zod schema validation ensuring outputs stay strictly within expected parameters.

### Q: How do your freelance sprints and contract engagements work?

Samir brings ambiguity tolerance, full-stack technical depth, and direct ownership from customer problem to deployed code.

### Privacy Policy
**URL**: https://samir-portfolio-dev.vercel.app/privacy-policy

This portfolio website collects minimal personal data limited to:
- **Contact form submissions**: Name, email address, and message content — used solely to respond to enquiries. Not sold, shared, or used for marketing.
- **Google Analytics 4**: Anonymised, aggregate usage data (pages visited, time on page, referral source, browser/device type). No personally identifiable information is linked to analytics data. Opt-out available via [Google Analytics Opt-out Add-on](https://tools.google.com/dlpage/gaoptout).
- **Server logs (Vercel)**: Standard HTTP request data (IP, path, user agent, timestamp) retained and managed by Vercel for security and reliability purposes.

**Cookies set**: `_ga`, `_ga_*` (Google Analytics, 2-year / 24-hour expiry). Theme preference stored in localStorage (no personal data).

**Third-party data processors**:
- Vercel — hosting and edge infrastructure
- Neon (Serverless PostgreSQL) — contact form database storage
- Google Analytics — anonymised usage analytics
- Cloudinary — image and media hosting

**Data retention**: Contact form submissions retained until the enquiry is resolved. GA data retained for 14 months (Google's default).

**User rights**: Right to access, correct, or delete personal data submitted through this site. Contact: shaikh.samir.work@gmail.com with subject "Data Request". Response within 30 days.
